faqs: Office hours: Monday through Friday, 9am to 5pm Pacific.
Service area: Spokane and Spokane Valley.
Estimates: Ask what work is needed. Save the confirmed estimate request for the office. No visit or callback timeframe has been approved; capture the caller’s preferred time without promising it.
Existing appointments: The office can check the schedule; do not invent an arrival time.
get_business_profile.pricingGuidance: Do not quote repair prices. Collect the issue and request an estimate from the team.
get_business_profile.emergencyGuidance: For immediate danger, gas smell, fire, or a medical emergency, advise calling 911 and moving to safety. Do not promise emergency dispatch.
get_business_profile.appointmentRule: Capture a request for the team; no booking, cancellation or reschedule is confirmed.
get_business_profile.privateAccountRule: Do not disclose private customer/account details to an unverified caller.

check_after_hours_policy.source: Synthetic QA fixture using approved business policy; NOT live hours verification

save_call_request.nextAction: The request is saved for team review. Office delivery, a booking, dispatch and a callback time are not confirmed.

complete_call.nextAction: This result records the call; it does not authorize a hangup. Keep listening. Only invoke endCall after the caller explicitly says goodbye or asks to end, after their latest question has been answered. Okay, thanks, or request confirmation alone is not a goodbye. A new question cancels any planned closing.

transfer_call.message: Synthetic QA: service unavailable; no action performed

limitations: Static save result does not echo or validate arguments; review actual requested arguments and separate backend tests
Set completion disposition per scenario, never report request_captured for FAQ-only or failed save
Unavailable mock is a handled result string, not HTTP error or network timeout
Frozen hours test date reasoning against a fixture, not actual call-time lookup
Fixture local date must be aligned to runtime clock before new relative-date batches; older frozen Saturday runs crossing midnight cannot establish live-date accuracy.
